title: Accessory parameters of the Heun equation
exact_target: Describe and count the Heun accessory parameters producing spherical unitary monodromy, including the real-parameter case.
definition_tex:
\subsection{Definitions and mathematical statement}
Fix distinct $a_0,a_1,a_2\in\mathbb C$, real numbers
$\alpha_0,\alpha_1,\alpha_2>0$, and real $\alpha',\alpha''$
satisfying $\alpha_0+\alpha_1+\alpha_2+\alpha'+\alpha''=2$.
Put $A=\alpha'\alpha''$ and consider the family
\[
 y''+\left(\sum_{j=0}^2\frac{1-\alpha_j}{z-a_j}\right)y'
       +\frac{Az-\lambda}{(z-a_0)(z-a_1)(z-a_2)}y=0,
       \qquad\lambda\in\mathbb C.
\]
It has regular singularities at the three finite marked points
and at infinity. The variable $\lambda$ is the accessory
parameter; all other data are held fixed.

For two independent local solutions, analytic continuation of
their ratio around punctures gives a group of Möbius
transformations, well-defined up to conjugacy. Let $E$ consist
of the parameters for which this group is conjugate to a
subgroup of $\operatorname{PSU}(2)$, the group induced by
unitary $2$-by-$2$ matrices of determinant one on the
Riemann sphere.

Describe $E$ explicitly in terms of the prescribed data.
In particular, characterize exactly when it is nonempty and
give an explicit upper bound for its cardinality in terms of
the exponent data $\alpha_j,A$. Also answer these questions
in the real version, where the marked points are real and
only real $\lambda$ are admitted. The primary source records
that $E$ is finite; the target is effective description,
existence criteria, and quantitative bounds, rather than
reproving finiteness.

\subsection{Short English statement}
Describe and count the Heun accessory parameters producing spherical unitary monodromy, including the real-parameter case.
